study type: Case-control study with molecular and in-vitro experiments
exposure: Genetic variants in PPARg2 promoter (e.g., -807A/C, rs948820149)
Transcription factor glucocorticoid receptor b (GRb) binding
cohort: The study included 400 pregnancies with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and 400 gestational-age matched control pregnancies from Chinese women.
finding: A novel -807A/C variant in the PPARg2 promoter was identified in Chinese women with GDM, which was found to affect GRb binding and down-regulate PPARg2 expression and adipogenesis.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy (GDM diagnosis is made during pregnancy)
gest_age: Gestational-age matched control pregnancies were used.
